name: Weather Maker
description: Post-only quotes (join the touch) on KXHIGH daily-high brackets priced 5-50c, before a local-time cutoff, pulled after fast mid moves, with per-city-day exposure caps. Earns the spread retail pays; weather has no maker fees.
hypothesis: Takers lose 0.3-1.6c/ct on weather (cheap brackets worst) and prices are about right vs forecasts, so the spread is the money. Counterparty: retail takers paying 2-3c spreads. Wrong if markouts after fills (adverse selection from forecast/obs updates) exceed the half-spread captured, or if CI of PnL per city-day clusters includes 0.
next: Needs 5-city full tests (sandbox memory) and a better adverse-selection filter (forecast/obs-driven pulling); NY-only v3 inconclusive (+0.88c/ct CI [-4.4,6.3]).
